source_access_notes: Independently reviewed ERC 2025 first aid and adult basic life support guidelines, Red Cross unresponsive casualty guidance (movement for safety, CPR or bleeding control), Royal Wolverhampton NHS helmet and trauma guidance, and Italian assistance provisions. 31595/31597 explicitly scope the lay sequence to adults; 31584–31589/31598 preserve urgent lifesaving exceptions without advising unnecessary movement.

issues.reason: Il quiz stampa VERO per la verifica immediata del battito da parte di chiunque soccorra un incosciente, ma le istruzioni correnti per soccorritori laici chiedono di valutare risposta e respirazione, senza verifica del polso; non è chiarito se il quesito intenda personale qualificato o una procedura superata. prior_review_findings.review_evidence: All 25 Italian questions/verdicts and four languages reviewed; no figures. ERC 2025 first aid and adult BLS directly inspected; 31595/31597 properly call immediately, assess breathing and begin CPR when abnormal without delaying for pulse. American Red Cross directly inspected movement exceptions for CPR and severe bleeding; 31584–86 omit these and can imply waiting instead of lifesaving care. 31587–89 and 31598 use example wording, but may benefit from explicit urgent-care context. Normattiva 2016 reproduces CdS189(1); Gazzetta art593, NHS helmet and European Commission emergency numbers inspected.
